Definition: from G575 and G1725; from in front, i.e. opposite, before or against:--before, contrary, over against, in the presence of.
BiblicalUsage: Over against, before — Mary Magdalene sitting over against the sepulchre, watching where they laid him, and the plain charge that there is no fear of God before the eyes of the godless. The word places things face to face.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe what stands before my eyes shapes what I do next, and Mary watching the tomb is the right picture of it.
